list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat: add Astryx web pilot, cloud SaaS ADRs, and observability export
- Add ADRs 0001-0009 covering Personal SaaS identity and workspace, account status gates, the Astryx pilot decision, OpenBot-owned intelligence state, self-hosted Corsair, Bifrost model routing, the single Credit ledger, and OpenObserve observability - Pilot Astryx on the /bots list and Create Bot flow: new astryx-pilot theme and field/action components wired into bots.index.tsx, bot-roster.tsx, and new-bot-sheet.tsx, with layout, PRODUCT.md, and test updates - Add the Astryx pilot doc and migration specs for Astryx and Corsair - Add AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and docs/agents guides for issue tracking, triage labels, and domain docs - Update domain glossaries and GLOSSARY-MAP, adding the billing glossary - Export audit events as OpenTelemetry records with run correlation fields in server/src/audit.ts, adding OTel deps, .env.example vars, and lockfile updates - Ignore .idea/ in .gitignore and add its IDE-local ignore file
